name: io.github.oxbshw/watch-skill
summary: Watch video and live sessions, keep timestamped evidence, and verify an agent's own work.

name: Watch
summary: Watch any video (URL, stream, or local path) via Watch Skill. Downloads, extracts scene-aware deduped frames, OCRs them, transcribes (captions first, then local Whisper — offline by default), indexes everything, and hands the result to the agent. Follow-up questions are answered from the persistent index without re-processing.
